2. Vakalatnama filed by Shri Mahmood Alam, Advocate on behalf of respondent complainant is

3.  The applicant seeks enlargement the on bail in FIR/ Case Crime No.357 of 2024, under Sections 376-D, 420, 323, 506, 342 I.P.C. and Section 67 of the Information Technology Act, Police Station- Mohanlalganj, District Lucknow.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant argued that the co accused Mohd. Khaleel has been enlarged on bail vide order dated 25.9.2024 passed by this Court.
However, the applicant does not claim parity with the said co accused.
In terms of the statement of the victim recorded under Section 180 and 183 B.N.S.S., the victim has admitted that she was married and was having children.
She also stated that the victim stayed with the applicant at his house for almost one month.
The tentative age of the victim is approximately 28 years.
He lastly argues that the applicant has no criminal antecedents and he is in jail since 14.8.2024, hence he may be enlarged on bail.
4. Learned counsel for the respondent complainant A.G.A. have strongly opposed the bail application.

5. Considering the two statements of the victim and the fact that the victim herself claimed that she was married and stayed with the applicant for one month coupled with the fact that the applicant has no criminal antecedents and is languishing in jail since 14.8.2024, the applicant is entitled to be enlarged on bail.
6. Accordingly, the bail application is allowed.
